description: This file is an HTML source file for a webpage that documents and sets up a CodeMirror mode for editing LESS code. It includes references to JavaScript and CSS resources, initializes the CodeMirror editor with LESS syntax highlighting, and contains content explaining the LESS mode. The main purpose is to serve as a webpage interface for editing LESS code with syntax highlighting.

methods.name: CodeMirror.fromTextArea
methods.description: Initializes a CodeMirror editor instance from a textarea element, with specified configuration options including lineNumbers, matchBrackets, and mode.
